summary: Iter 11 validates Pro Mapping Studio end-to-end. 20/23 flow checks PASS. The /templates → Pick → Capture → mapmode-pro → Continue to Pro Studio route lands on pro-studio correctly. 13 tools render in the toolbar; only boundary is enabled initially; after 4 anchor taps on studio-canvas, studio-count reads 'ANCHORS 4/4' and all other tools become enabled. Drag tools (rect, line, circle, text_marker with prefilled field, logo upload, qr upload) commit elements and Inspector updates. Clean tab renders paper-sheet with inline <svg>. Assets tab accepts logo + qr uploads and surfaces studio-logo-change / studio-qr-change buttons. studio-undo removes last element. studio-lock is correctly enabled only with 1+ elements AND 4/4 anchors. studio-toggle-legacy opens the legacy ProMappingEditor; studio-exit-legacy returns to the Studio. studio-save persists and navigates to /dashboard with a 'Template activated' toast. Font select exposes all 5 presets (arial, times, roboto, courier, condensed). CRITICAL BUG FOUND: tap-accumulation tools (triangle 3-tap, corners 4-tap, bullet 2-tap) DO NOT commit elements because onPointerUp's trailing 'else setDraft(null)' (ProMappingStudio.jsx line 235-237) clears the in-progress draft.points between taps. Dashboard paper-sheet render of schema.version===2 could not be visually verified because the first-run 'About you' one-time profile modal intercepts the dashboard on this test session — not a regression of the Studio itself.

ui_bugs.issue: Triangle (3 taps) and Corners (4 taps) tap-accumulation tools never commit an element. Each tap triggers onPointerDown which appends to draft.points, but the subsequent onPointerUp falls through to the trailing `else { setDraft(null); }` branch (line 235-237) and wipes the draft before the next tap. Net effect: after 3/4 taps only 0 elements are produced. Same root cause also breaks the Bullet tool (2-tap sequence of dot + text-start).

critical_code_review_comments: ProMappingStudio.jsx onPointerUp (line 180-238): the catch-all `else { setDraft(null); }` on line 235-237 blindly wipes any in-progress draft whose tool is not one of the drag-commit tools. Because triangle/corners/bullet build up their geometry via multiple onPointerDown taps (draft.points accumulated), onPointerUp fires between each tap and destroys the accumulator. Fix: explicitly no-op for tap-accumulation tools, e.g. `else if (['triangle','corners','bullet'].includes(d.tool)) { /* keep draft */ } else { setDraft(null); }`.

ProMappingStudio.jsx grid tool uses window.prompt() (line 205-206) inside onPointerUp — this is unreliable on mobile Safari and blocks automated tests. Consider a small inline modal with rows/cols inputs.

ProMappingStudio.jsx is ~867 lines in a single file — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting MarkupOverlay, DraftOverlay, CleanReconstructionPreview, InspectorPane, AssetsPane into sibling files.
studio-count text appears in an uppercase CSS class; any future assertions should be case-insensitive (tests caught this). Not a bug, just a testability note.

Fix the branch, then re-run the triangle/corners/bullet rows of this report and also retest DynamicPaperSheet schema.version===2 clean render on dashboard preview modal (dismiss the 'About you' first-run form before opening the template preview).
rca of the issue: onPointerUp runs after every pointer-up regardless of tool. For drag tools the branch that matches commits or resets. For triangle/corners/bullet (tap-accumulation), none of the explicit branches match (they rely only on onPointerDown to push into draft.points and auto-commit on the Nth tap). Control therefore reaches the final `else { setDraft(null); }`, which wipes draft between every tap, so draft.points never grows past 1 and the auto-commit condition (length===3 / ===4 / bullet second-tap) is never satisfied.
